Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski Regional Transportation Engineer Division of Highways 300 North State Street, Room 907 Chicago, Illinois 60610
Subject: NIPC Project No. 72-A-20 Draft Environmental Statement and Section 4 (f) Statement for Lincoln Highway Improvement - Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road, Cook County, Illinois.
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
We have reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed Lincoln Highway improvement and find it generally consistent with Section 201 (2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. We would like to comment, however, on the relationship of the proposal to a specific recommendation of the Regional Open Space Plan for northeastern Illinois.
The Regional Open Space Plan discourages the conversion of open space land to other uses without the provision of equivalent replacement area. The taking of Roosevelt School property, in spite of the compensatory street area to be provided for playground use, would result in a net loss of 4385 square feet from the school site. The existing school site is slightly less than three acres. A standard frequently used for elementary school sites is a minimum of five acres and the desired standard is five acres plus one acre for each one hundred students. The existing site is clearly below the minimum standard and would have to have 7.7 acres to achieve the desirable minimum given the current enrollment. Reducing the site further is obviously undesirable and ways of compensating for the deficit 4385 square feet should be given further consideration.
We have no further comments on possible environmental impacts from the proposed highway widening. The Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission may provide additional comments when the project is reviewed under the A-95 procedures.
